name: Mori no Shiro Yagi-san to Kuro Yagi-san
original_name: 森の白ヤギさんと黒ヤギさん
source:
In a deep forest lived a young wolf girl.
Every year, she celebrated the "Shooting Star Festival," and this time, she invited her dear friends—White Goat and Black Goat—to her home.
But no matter how long she waited, they never came.
Worried, she stepped into the dark, cold woods to find them.
Little did she know, this journey would also lead her to discover the flutterings of love.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/6827]Freem[/url]]
translation:
深邃的森林里住着一位年轻的狼女孩。
每年她都会庆祝“流星祭”，这一次还邀请了亲爱的朋友——白山羊和黑山羊——到家里。
可是无论等了多久，她们都没有来。
她担心地踏入幽暗寒冷的森林去寻找她们。
她不知道，这段旅程也将让她发现爱情的悸动。
